Omit unnecessary abstract geometric ornaments or random floating shards; do not add a prop merely to fill the hand.
characters.pose: Elegant sideways RECLINING flight almost horizontal, torso raised slightly on one bent elbow, one leg stretches long diagonally down-right and the other knee folds gently toward waist, free hand directs the foremost ward wing. Opaque skirt drapes naturally over correct pelvis; full body with spacious margins.
characters.clothingRevision: White amethyst opaque deep-V fitted bodice with an open back and side waist cutouts, short broad diamond skirt panels over opaque shorts, bare thighs above boots; no stockings.
characters.sourceSkillDescription: Increases defense [defup] of allies within [dist] for [time] and resists laser.
characters.faceAndHair: Snow-white very long wavy hair with a single amethyst lion-tail ornament; pale-violet small almond eyes, low straight brows, broad calm adult cheeks, serene faint closed smile. Distinctly beautiful feminine adult anime face, smooth soft jawline, small delicate nose, lush eyelashes and shaped lips; avoid masculine face or broad male jaw. Vary eyes and expressions while maintaining female appeal.
characters.finalCostume: White amethyst gold-edged lion-star high commander robes: opaque fitted bustier breastplate, elegant detached sleeves, long broad diamond-shaped skirt panels and one bare thigh, white silver boots. A single large crystal-faced absorption SHIELD cupped near elbow with a visible beam dissolving into it; no generic sword, no ornate halo. Magnificent five-star celestial-fantasy silhouette.
characters.skinPreference: 不是一律白皙；依個別角色的整體效果與使用者逐張核定。OTS44原版膚色已接受，禁止自動改白；水委一原版膚色被拒絕，單獨修正。
characters.referenceNote: 圖鑑列名但無可用原圖：依吸收屏障與獅子座／五帝座一意象原創，不稱官方外觀。
characters.look: Snow-white very long soft waves with one amethyst lion-tail-shaped hair ornament, pale-violet large eyes with gentle upward outer corners, delicate lashes, soft mature feminine oval face, serene confident tiny smile. White amethyst gold-edged lion-star goddess commander dress with opaque fitted low-cut bodice, detached translucent sleeves, broad flowing diamond-shaped skirt panels with high side slit and one visible bare leg, white silver boots. THREE LARGE angular CRYSTAL WARD WINGS float near her back and arm, showing a single beam dissolving into their crystalline faces; clearly a defensive absorption system, no sword or book. Five-star majestic defense goddess, glamorous dress and bold crystal equipment but same restrained rendering density.
characters.visualReview: 已逐張查看：軀幹、骨盆與兩腿方向重建；保留待使用者審閱狀態。

characters.name: 天樞
characters.design: midnight-blue hair in high braided crown with one thick long tail, gold eyes, dignified adult face; black ivory simple gold-edged great-bear marshal long coat over fitted opaque bodice and straight trousers, large sculptural shoulder armor and heavy boots. Seven clear geometric blue shield plates float in a shallow arc only; no staff, astrolabe, cape, throne or jewelry chains. Any equipment must have a clear recognizable construction and purpose. Omit unnecessary abstract geometric ornaments or random floating shards; do not add a prop merely to fill the hand.
characters.pose: Commanding long forward march in midair, one thigh raised to hip height and knee bent while other leg extends down behind, hips rotated to left, torso front, one hand gives two-finger aiming command near temple, other arm lowered at side. Do not repeat palm-out or crossed-leg standing poses.
characters.clothingRevision: Black ivory open marshal coat with broad simple gold-edged lapels over opaque low-cut bustier, bare waist, high-cut tailored shorts with a short asymmetric hip panel, bare thighs and heavy boots; no trousers.
characters.sourceSkillDescription: After randomly designating an enemy 5 times, deal [atksplashdmg] damage to the [splashrange] range.
characters.faceAndHair: Midnight-blue hair in a high braided crown and thick long tail; gold wide eyes with small pupils, strong long dark brows, slim softly rounded feminine jaw, composed authoritative neutral mouth. Distinctly beautiful feminine adult anime face, smooth soft jawline, small delicate nose, lush eyelashes and shaped lips; avoid masculine face or broad male jaw. Vary eyes and expressions while maintaining female appeal.
characters.finalCostume: Black ivory dark-gold great-bear supreme star-fleet admiral: opaque fitted breastplate, high broad collar, asymmetrical military coat, fitted dark trousers, large plated boots and bear-emblem shoulder armor. Five clear small CANNON DRONES in a shallow open V formation around shoulders, each with actual barrel and blue targeting optics, matching five-target energy bombing. One hand commands firing. No throne, staff, astrolabe or chains. Feminine fitted armor silhouette. Leave shoulders and waist-side exposed, replace full trousers with short armored skirt panels and opaque short underlayer, bare upper thighs above long boots. Keep purpose-specific equipment.
characters.skinPreference: 不是一律白皙；依個別角色的整體效果與使用者逐張核定。OTS44原版膚色已接受，禁止自動改白；水委一原版膚色被拒絕，單獨修正。
characters.referenceNote: 未找到可靠原作圖：依五次指定目標轟炸技能、大熊／天樞意象原創，不稱官方外觀。
characters.look: Midnight-blue long hair braided into a high crown with a smooth thick trailing ponytail, warm gold sparkling eyes with long lashes, fine gently arched brows, feminine soft cheeks and composed confident closed smile. Black ivory antique-gold great-bear admiral dress, shaped opaque breastplate with tasteful low neckline, high cape collar around back only leaving shoulders visible, side waist skin gaps, short asymmetric military skirt over opaque shorts, bare thighs above white long plated boots. FIVE clear FLOATING CANNON DRONES in a wide open V formation, actual short barrels and blue targeting lenses, small bear-star emblem. Five-star supreme fleet commander with imposing functional gun formation, cool and alluring; no staff, throne or circular astrolabe.
